title: Repair standalone SCHC host test link source list
description: lichen/tests/schc/CMakeLists.txt compiles generic and LICHEN SCHC sources but omits the helper/compress/decompress implementation files required by lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/schc.c. The focused host build reaches link then fails with unresolved ipv6_version, compress_coap, decompress_coap, ICMPv6/RPL helpers, etc. Add the authoritative source/library wiring without duplicate implementations. Acceptance: clean host build links and schc_test runs all vectors successfully.
